issues.reason: Total revenue line includes equity share in profits of associates/JVs. It is separately keyed revenue_and_equity_income, not silently treated as IFRS sales revenue.
Company FCF is adjusted for long-term supply prepayments and other disclosed items; it differs materially from simple CFO minus cash capex. Both series have separate keys.
Financial amounts normalized billion RUB to million RUB; cash capex excludes separately disclosed licence purchases.
2023–2025 statements are summary IFRS-derived disclosures. 2023–2024 include cash flows; 2025 omits cash flows. Missing 2025 flows remain missing.
Production includes consolidated subsidiaries and equity share in associates/JVs under MDA definition. Pro forma Bashneft rows excluded; acquired assets change the perimeter in 2016.

2022 financial disclosure is partial: EBITDA and parent profit from annual report only; revenue, group profit and cash flows are not inferred. Annual gas excludes flaring/NGL gas under historical MDA; 2023 explicitly excludes other process needs.
Publication dates not yet confirmed: no LTM or daily valuation series. Revisions retained; this is not a point-in-time backtest.
